**Current positioning (WO2, what the journal accepts now):** Generalist French-language psychology journal (not tied to one theoretical school); publishes empirical studies, clinical case studies, theoretical/historical reviews, and doctoral thesis long-summaries (2000-2600 words, submitted within 2 years of defense). Recent 2025 issues (n°589, n°590) show a mix of thematic special issues (e.g. a Joseph Gabel retrospective issue mixing social psychology/critical theory/history of ideas) and 'Varia' issues covering clinical psychoanalysis, forensic/prison psychology, digital mental health (Lacanian reading), and psychometric method pieces (word-association test).

**Methods noted as welcome (WO2, qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** empirical/quantitative studies, clinical case studies, theoretical and historical essays, psychoanalytic/clinical readings, doctoral thesis summaries, book reviews
